parse_language_code: parse a language code string like 'es' or 'en-US' into a langcodes Language object
language_code_to_short_code: convert a language code to its alpha-2 or alpha-3 short code with optional macrolanguage replacement
LanguageMatcher_match: match an input language code to the nearest supported target language using genetic and geographic proximity
LanguageMatcher_set_target_langs: initialize a LanguageMatcher with a list of target language codes in NLLB format like 'eng_Latn'
SONAR_LANGS: access the list of approximately 200 language codes supported by the SONAR sentence encoder
